## Checklist

- [ ] Archi Validator reports no warning.
- [ ] Every new element, relationship, folder and view carries an English documentation text (no ArchiMate definition reproduced or paraphrased).
- [ ] Names are singular, in Title Case; specialisations in Title Case without "#".
- [ ] A specialisation is set only where it changes the meaning.
- [ ] No relationship between architecture content and the generic elements of the metamodels.
- [ ] Views are named `<code> <Subject>` and carry the property NAF Viewpoint (and Architecture State where relevant).
- [ ] Lifecycle Status and Change Reference are set on planned content (instances).
- [ ] Any deviation from NAF is documented in the guide concerned.
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated (template changes).
